name: Antoine Poinsot
cooked: On my non-publicly-reachable node running from New York, i received slowish blocks 297387 through 297392 at (UTC) 13:10:33, 13:11:27, 13:12:24, 13:14:00, 13:14:53 and 13:15:41. They all came from the same peer. The first one via simple header announcement, the five others through compact blocks.
